videos.name: the_grave_en
videos.title: The Grave
videos.title_en: What Stays With You in the Grave
videos.caption: Your family and your wealth will walk away. Only your deeds will stay 🤍

lines.text: One day, they will carry you to your grave.
lines.say: One day, | they will carry you | to your *grave*.

lines.text: Your family will walk with you…
lines.say: Your family will walk with you,

lines.text: and then they will walk away.
lines.say: and then | they will walk away.

lines.text: The Prophet ﷺ said:
lines.say: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: Three follow the dead person to his grave:
lines.say: *Three* follow the dead person | to his grave:

lines.text: his family, his wealth, and his deeds.
lines.say: his family, | his wealth, | and his deeds.

lines.text: Two return, and one remains with him:
lines.say: *Two* return, | and one remains with him:

lines.text: his deeds.
lines.say: his *deeds*.

lines.text: And in the grave, you will be asked:
lines.say: And in the grave, | you will be asked:

lines.text: Who is your Lord? What is your religion?
lines.say: Who is your *Lord*? | What is your religion?

lines.text: What do you say about the man who was sent among you?
lines.say: What do you say | about the man | who was sent among you?

lines.text: Prepare your answer today.
lines.say: Prepare your answer | *today*.

lines.text: يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
lines.sub: “Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter.” (Ibrahim 14:27)
lines.say: Allah keeps firm those who believe, | with the firm word, | in worldly life | and in the Hereafter.

sources.wording: faithful rendering of the linked English translation
faithful rendering of the linked English translation

videos.name: qiyamah_en
videos.title: The Day of Judgment
videos.title_en: The Day No One Can Help You
videos.caption: On that Day a man will flee from his own brother… What will you have brought? 🤍

lines.text: Imagine the Day the sky splits open.
lines.say: *Imagine* the Day | the sky splits open.

lines.text: “It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,”
lines.say: It is the Day | when people will be like moths, | dispersed,

lines.text: “and the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.”
lines.say: and the mountains | will be like wool, | fluffed up.

lines.text: “On the Day a man will flee from his brother,”
lines.say: On the Day | a man will flee | from his *brother*,

lines.text: “and his mother and his father, and his wife and his children.”
lines.say: and his mother and his father, | and his wife and his children.

lines.text: The Prophet ﷺ said:
lines.say: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: the sun will draw so close to the people
lines.say: the *sun* will draw so close | to the people

lines.text: that only a mile will be left between them.
lines.say: that only a mile | will be left between them.

lines.text: On that Day, what will you have brought?
lines.say: On that Day, | what will *you* have brought?

lines.text: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
lines.sub: “So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.” (Az-Zalzalah 99:7–8)
lines.say: So whoever does an atom's weight of good | will see it, | and whoever does an atom's weight of evil | will see it.

sources.wording: faithful rendering of the linked English translation

videos.name: death_en
videos.title: Death
videos.title_en: Death Is Closer Than You Think
videos.caption: Death doesn't knock, and it won't wait until you're ready. Remember it often 🤍

lines.text: Every day, your time runs out a little more.
lines.say: Every day, | your time runs out | a little more.

lines.text: Death doesn’t knock.
lines.say: Death | doesn't knock.

lines.text: And it won’t wait until you’re ready.
lines.say: And it won't wait | until you're *ready*.

lines.text: Allah says:
lines.say: *Allah* says:

lines.text: “Indeed, the death from which you flee – indeed, it will meet you.”
lines.say: Indeed, the death from which you flee, | indeed, | it will meet you.

lines.text: “Wherever you may be, death will overtake you,”
lines.say: Wherever you may be, | death will overtake you,

lines.text: “even if you should be within towers of lofty construction.”
lines.say: even if you should be | within towers of lofty construction.

lines.text: The Prophet ﷺ said:
lines.say: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: Remember often the destroyer of pleasures – death.
lines.say: Remember often | the destroyer of pleasures: | *death*.

lines.text: So live for the life that never ends.
lines.say: So live | for the life | that never ends.

lines.text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ
lines.say: Every soul | will taste *death*.

sources.wording: faithful rendering of the linked English translation

videos.name: allah_mercy_en
videos.title: Allah's Mercy
videos.title_en: Never Lose Hope in Allah's Mercy
videos.caption: Do you think your sins are too many? Allah forgives all sins 🤍

lines.text: Do you think your sins are too many?
lines.say: Do you think | your sins | are too *many*?

lines.text: Listen to what Allah says:
lines.say: Listen | to what *Allah* says:

lines.text: “O My servants who have transgressed against themselves,”
lines.say: O My servants | who have transgressed against themselves,

lines.text: “do not despair of the mercy of Allah.”
lines.say: do not *despair* | of the mercy of Allah.

lines.text: “Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.”
lines.say: Indeed, | Allah forgives *all* sins.

lines.text: The Prophet ﷺ said:
lines.say: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: Allah divided mercy into one hundred parts.
lines.say: Allah divided mercy | into one hundred parts.

lines.text: He kept ninety-nine parts with Him,
lines.say: He kept *ninety-nine* parts | with Him,

lines.text: and sent down one part to the earth.
lines.say: and sent down | one part | to the earth.

lines.text: Because of that one part, His creatures are merciful to each other.
lines.say: Because of that one part, | His creatures are merciful | to each other.

lines.text: Now imagine the ninety-nine.
lines.say: Now | *imagine* the ninety-nine.

lines.text: وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.say: My mercy | encompasses all things.

sources.wording: faithful rendering of the linked English translation

videos.name: tawbah_en
videos.title: It's Not Too Late
videos.title_en: It's Not Too Late to Come Back to Allah
videos.caption: Even if your sins reached the clouds of the sky… come back to Him tonight 🤍

lines.text: It’s not too late to come back.
lines.say: It's not too late | to come *back*.

lines.text: The Prophet ﷺ said:
lines.say: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:

lines.text: Allah stretches out His Hand during the night
lines.say: Allah stretches out His Hand | during the night

lines.text: so the one who sinned by day may repent,
lines.say: so the one who sinned by day | may repent,

lines.text: and during the day, so the one who sinned by night may repent,
lines.say: and during the day, | so the one who sinned by night | may repent,

lines.text: until the sun rises from the west.
lines.say: until the sun rises | from the *west*.

lines.text: And in a hadith qudsi, Allah says:
lines.say: And in a hadith qudsi, | Allah says:

lines.text: “O son of Adam, were your sins to reach the clouds of the sky,”
lines.say: O son of Adam, | were your sins to reach | the clouds of the sky,

lines.text: “and you then asked My forgiveness, I would forgive you.”
lines.say: and you then asked My forgiveness, | I would *forgive* you.

lines.text: But the door won’t stay open forever.
lines.say: But the door | won't stay open *forever*.

lines.text: Allah accepts a servant’s repentance until his soul reaches his throat.
lines.say: Allah accepts a servant's repentance | until his soul | reaches his throat.

lines.text: So turn back to Him tonight.
lines.say: So turn back to Him | *tonight*.

lines.text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ
lines.sub: “Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant.” (Al-Baqarah 2:222)
lines.say: Indeed, | Allah loves those | who are constantly repentant.
